name: style_sniffer
description: Sniff project code style (indent, quotes, semicolons, naming, trailing commas) from sample files, generate PROJECT_RULES.md content. Deterministic sampling, zero LLM. Pass output to write rules file.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: project root (abs). reindex first if new.

scope.description: Scan scope: directory relative to workspace_dir (default: ".")

output.description: Directory to write PROJECT_RULES.md into (default: none, returns content only)
